summary: Proposes a way around the race condition in the Initial Connection Protocol described in RFC 143. The Host-Host protocol did not say what to do with several requests to the same socket, so implementations differ. The suggestion is to fix it in a third-level protocol rather than change the Host-Host protocol.

eli5.summary: Two friends keep trying to call each other at the same instant. Instead of changing the phone system, the note changes how they start the call.
